name: Tsubasa o Motta Kare wa Warawanai!!
original_name: ツバサを持った彼は笑わない！！
source:
"I" traveled deep into the mountains to photograph a specific bird.
There, I met a bird enthusiast who seemed expressionless yet... outgoing?
[Translated from [url=https://siokanya.xrea.jp/tubasa.html]official website[/url]]
